comments.content:
This pre-init call is not idempotent: `WorkspaceStore.create(name, id)` (plugins/omnimux-workflow/src/workflow/workspace/WorkspaceStore.ts:192) unconditionally `atomicWriteJson`s an empty `version: 0` snapshot to the home canvas file — there is no existence check in the route (workspaceRoutes.ts:163-169). So if `workspaceId` already exists, this wipes its snapshot (content + version) before the PUT.

That is reachable here: `createProject` returns the *existing* project when the chosen `projectRoot` already contains `project.json` (ProjectStore.create, line 296-300), so `newProject.canvasWorkspaceIds[0]` can be a live workspace id. In the case where that workspace's canvas is still only in the home file (e.g. saved before the workspace got project-bound), this silently destroys the user's canvas, then the PUT re-creates an empty one. The subsequent `.catch(() => null)` also discards any failure/`ok:false`, so the init can fail with no diagnostic at all.

Suggest checking existence first (GET returns 404 `workspace-not-found` when absent) and only creating when missing.

So 'internal' leaks. Also 'unreadable' etc.
